units.source_text: 二楼小格子窗前的一块古老的招牌，映入了她的眼帘。

en.t: An old signboard in front of the small lattice window on the second floor caught her eye.

units.source_text: 招牌上面，有个小小的屋顶。

en.t: Above the signboard was a tiny roof.

units.source_text: 这像是老铺子的标志，也像是一种装饰。

en.t: It seemed like the mark of an old shop, and also like a kind of decoration.
